```sql
alter table public.app_config enable row level security;
alter table public.user_flag_overrides enable row level security;

create policy app_config_select_public
  on public.app_config
  for select
  to anon, authenticated
  using (is_public);

revoke all on public.app_config from anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.app_config to anon, authenticated;

create policy user_flag_overrides_select_own
  on public.user_flag_overrides
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy user_flag_overrides_insert_own
  on public.user_flag_overrides
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.app_config c
      where c.key = user_flag_overrides.key
        and c.is_public
        and c.user_overridable
    )
  );

create policy user_flag_overrides_update_own
  on public.user_flag_overrides
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid())
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.app_config c
      where c.key = user_flag_overrides.key
        and c.is_public
        and c.user_overridable
    )
  );

create policy user_flag_overrides_delete_own
  on public.user_flag_overrides
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());
```
